# launchproof

> launchproof is a Claude Code and Codex plugin that turns a finished project folder into a public-ready GitHub repo and a launch plan. It scans the full git history for personal emails, home paths, secrets and private names; writes the README (proof, sourced comparison, limitations, FAQ), community health files, CI, release notes, llms.txt, AGENTS.md and a GitHub Pages page with JSON-LD; scores the repo with a 0 to 100 checklist and fixes gaps; and drafts launch posts. It never pushes, publishes or posts. No API key: it runs on the agent's own model with a standard-library Python helper. MIT licensed.

Install: `claude plugin marketplace add deserteaglemj/launchproof` then `claude plugin install launchproof@launchproof` (Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add deserteaglemj/launchproof` then `codex plugin add launchproof@launchproof`). Use: `/launchproof` in a project folder.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/launchproof/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, proof, comparison, limitations, FAQ
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/launchproof/blob/main/plugins/launchproof/skills/launchproof/SKILL.md): the workflow the agent follows
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/launchproof/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands and layout for coding agents
- [Eval results](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/launchproof/blob/main/evals/RESULTS.md): 3 cases, 2 pass, method and limits
- [Prior art](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/launchproof/blob/main/docs/research/prior-art.md): related tools, scored, and what was reused
